text: Replaced URL-presence verification with a v1 offline bundle contract. Exact repository/commit/branch, timestamp, URL, payload path/hash, workflow/run/job facts, both regeneration artifacts and candidate source hashes, plus branch contexts derived from captured CI job names are enforced. Ten stdlib tests cover absent/malformed/legacy URL, foreign/stale evidence, queued/in-progress/failed/skipped runs, missing artifacts/checks, tampering, and a fully verified bundle.
